items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: But we played around Chicago, we had a band around -- we had a little band around Chicago, and we joined Art Tatum at the same time.

ctx.x: Had tremendous technique, very big sound. He was with Earl Hines, he did some very good things. He was with Earl Hines for quite a while. But we played around Chicago, we had a band around -- we had a little band around Chicago, and we joined Art Tatum at the same time. The Scoops was like a virtuoso on the saxophone. Scoops Carey, I'm surprised you haven't heard of him. But he died -- he -- a couple of years ago. I went back to his funeral, and he had gone into law, and he was a very big lawyer in Chicago. But…
